name: How do I create a realistic budget for a major home renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I create a realistic budget for a major home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Creating a realistic budget for a major home renovation begins with a clear understanding of your goals and desired scope. We recommend first outlining your project vision and researching average costs for similar high-value renovations in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex. Our integrated design-build process helps establish a detailed budget from the outset, coordinating all aspects from design planning to material selections. It's essential to allocate a contingency fund, typically 10-20% of the total project cost, for unforeseen conditions or changes during construction. This proactive approach ensures financial clarity and helps manage expectations effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with your project vision and research similar high-value renovation costs in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex. Always include a 10-20% contingency fund for unforeseen changes.
